sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A BELT OF SEASONABLY FAST UPPER FLOW WILL STRETCH FROM THE PACIFIC NW EWD ACROSS THE NRN TIER OF STATES WITH 40-50 KT MID LEVEL FLOW INCREASING TO 80-100 KT AT 300 MB WITH AN TIGHT JET MAX ACROSS ND/MN. AT THE SURFACE...A WEAK LOW PRESSURE TROUGH WILL LIE ROUGHLY FROM PIERRE SD SWD INTO CNTRL NEB AND KS. SLY FLOW ACROSS THE PLAINS WILL HELP MAINTAIN MOISTURE ACROSS THE MO VALLEY WITH PLENTY OF INSTABILITY FOR STORMS. ELSEWHERE...DAYTIME STRONG STORMS ARE ANTICIPATED ACROSS THE SERN STATES IN LOW SHEAR WEAK CAPE ENVIRONMENT...AS WELL AS OVER SRN AZ WITH A MARGINAL WIND THREAT.

sections.title: ERN DAKOTAS INTO MN
sections.text: WARM ADVECTION WITH A SLY LOW LEVEL JET...IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE RIGHT ENTRANCE REGION OF AN UPPER LEVEL JET STREAK WILL LEAD TO RELATIVELY EARLY STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS CNTRL ND/N CNTRL SD BY ABOUT 18Z. SUBSTANTIAL LOW LEVEL MOISTURE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S F WILL LEAD TO STRONG INSTABILITY. RELATIVELY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES...IN CONJUNCTION WITH STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES AND STRAIGHT LINE HODOGRAPHS SHOULD LEAD TO SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL. BRIEF TORNADOES MAY OCCUR...BUT SHEAR PROFILES WILL MAINLY FAVOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. ACTIVITY WILL SPREAD SEWD ACROSS THE ERN DAKOTAS INTO MN DURING THE EVENING...POSSIBLY MERGING INTO AN MCS BUT SUPERCELLS SHOULD BE THE STORM MODE EARLY.

sections.title: IA...WI...NRN IL
sections.text: A FEW STORMS MAY BE ONGOING FROM SRN MN INTO WI EARLY SUNDAY IN A ZONE OF WEAK WARM ADVECTION AND LITTLE IF ANY CIN. SOME STORMS COULD HAVE A MARGINAL HAIL THREAT...DECREASING WITH SWD EXTENT AS SHEAR DECREASES. DEPENDING ON HOW MUCH OUTFLOW IS PRODUCED...THIS ACTIVITY MAY PRODUCE BOUNDARIES TO FOCUS AFTERNOON DEVELOPMENT WHICH WOULD HAVE A HAIL AND WIND THREAT AS WIND PROFILES ALOFT INCREASE AND INSTABILITY INCREASES. ASIDE FROM THESE POTENTIAL FOCI...OTHER ACTIVITY MAY FORM UPSTREAM AND AFFECT THIS REGION OVERNIGHT INTO MON MORNING. SOME MODELS HINT AT MCS DEVELOPMENT...BUT THERE ARE UNCERTAINTIES AND WILL MAINTAIN MINIMAL PROBABILITIES FOR A SLIGHT RISK AT THIS TIME. ..JEWELL/GARNER.. 07/10/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: ELONGATED UPR RIDGE...WITH MAIN CENTER OVER THE OZARKS/LWR TN VLY...WILL REMAIN THE DOMINANT FEATURE OVER THE LWR 48 THROUGH MON. TOPPING THE RIDGE...A BELT OF SEASONABLY STRONG ZONAL FLOW WILL PREVAIL FROM THE NRN RCKYS/NRN PLNS ACROSS THE UPR GRT LKS TO NEW ENGLAND. A JET STREAK WITHIN THIS FLOW...ASSOCIATED WITH UPR LOW NOW OVER SK/MB...WILL TRACK FROM NRN ND THIS MORNING TO SRN ONT BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. WITHIN THE JET...40-50 KT WLY 500 MB FLOW WILL INCREASE TO 100-110 KTS AT 300 MB. FEATURES WILL REMAIN WEAK AT THE SFC. A NNE-SSW ORIENTED TROUGH NOW OVER THE WRN DAKOTAS/FAR WRN NEB WILL MOVE SLOWLY E/SE THROUGH THE PERIOD. SLY FLOW AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE...AND LOCAL EVAPOTRANSPIRATION...WILL MAINTAIN MOISTURE ACROSS THE MID MO/UPR MS VLY REGION AND...COUPLED WITH EML PLUME ON N SIDE OF RIDGE...WILL MAINTAIN INSTABILITY FOR STORMS.

sections.title: ERN DAKOTAS INTO MN TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: MCS NOW OVER W CNTRL WI/SE MN SHOULD CONTINUE EWD THROUGH LATER THIS MORNING...SUPPORTED LARGELY BY MODEST WAA/MOISTURE TRANSPORT ALONG WEAK STNRY FRONT EXTENDING FROM SRN MN INTO CNTRL WI. SFC HEATING...MOIST LOW LVL ENVIRONMENT /PW TO 1.75 INCHES/...AND MODERATE MID/UPR LVL FLOW MAY SUPPORT MODEST INTENSIFICATION OF THE SYSTEM AS IT CROSSES WI. BUT WEAK LOW LVL INFLOW AND MODEST MID LVL LAPSE RATES RELATIVE TO POINTS WEST SHOULD LIMIT OVERALL SVR THREAT. LOCALLY DMGG WIND FROM EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS SHOULD POSE THE GREATEST THREAT /REF MCD 1557/. FARTHER S..ISOLD SOMEWHAT ELEVATED STORMS WITH A CONDITIONAL THREAT FOR SVR HAIL MAY PERSIST FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS IN WAA ZONE OVER THE NRN HALF OF IA. SUSTAINED LOW LVL WAA...CONFLUENCE AHEAD OF SFC TROUGH...AND ASCENT IN RIGHT ENTRANCE REGION OF AFOREMENTIONED UPR JET STREAK EXPECTED TO SUPPORT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER CNTRL ND/N CNTRL SD BY EARLY AFTN. A MORE CONDITIONAL RISK ALSO WILL EXIST FOR NEW STORMS OVER NRN IA WWD INTO NE NEB/SE SD...ALONG WEAK OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LEFT BY MN/WI MCS. AMPLE MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.25 INCHES AND SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPR 60S F/ BENEATH DEEP EML WILL LEAD TO VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /SBCA

sections.title: CNTRL HI PLNS INTO NEB THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY SUN
sections.text: SIMILAR TO YESTERDAY...SETUP WILL ONCE AGAIN BE FAVORABLE FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF STRONG AFTN/EVE STORMS OVER THE RCKYS OF CO AND SRN WY. THIS REGION WILL AGAIN LIE BENEATH BRANCH OF MODERATE /30+ KT/ WSWLY MID LVL FLOW IMMEDIATELY TOPPING S CNTRL U.S. UPR RIDGE. SETUP SHOULD FOSTER ENE PROPAGATION OF CONVECTION OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND INTO DEEPLY MIXED/FAIRLY MOIST ENVIRONMENT OVER THE CNTRL HI PLNS. SOME OF THE STORMS COULD YIELD SVR HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND. NOCTURNAL STRENGTHENING OF SLY LLJ AND PRESENCE OF DISTURBANCES IN THE SRN STREAM FLOW /PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY/ SUGGEST THAT THE STORMS WILL EVOLVE INTO A LARGE CLUSTER THAT COULD EXTEND THE RISK FOR DMGG WIND AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL AS FAR E AS CNTRL/ERN NEB BY EARLY SUN.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: SCTD STRONG DIURNAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED OVER PARTS OF THE SOUTHEAST IN LOW SHEAR/WEAK CAPE ENVIRONMENT...AS WELL AS OVER SRN AZ...WITH A MARGINAL WIND THREAT. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 07/10/2011

sections.title: ND/SD/MN
sections.text: THE ENTRANCE REGION TO A RELATIVELY STRONG MID/UPPER LEVEL JET OVER THE NORTHERN PLAINS IS HELPING TO PROVIDE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION OVER THE WESTERN DAKOTAS. THIS FEATURE WILL TRACK EASTWARD TODAY AND INTO MN THIS EVENING. MEANWHILE AT THE SURFACE...A RETREATING BOUNDARY EXTENDS ROUGHLY ALONG THE ND/SD BORDER WITH MOIST AND VERY UNSTABLE CONDITIONS TO THE SOUTH. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT STORMS WILL INTENSIFY NEAR THE BOUNDARY THROUGH THE DAY AND TRACK EASTWARD INTO MN. HIGH CAPE VALUES AND SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL STORMS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. BACKED LOW LEVEL WINDS AND HIGH BL MOISTURE VALUES ALSO SUGGEST A THREAT OF ISOLATED TORNADOES LATER THIS AFTERNOON WHEN STORMS ARE SURFACE-BASED. MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THE ACTIVITY MAY PERSIST WELL INTO THE EVENING AND TRACK ACROSS MUCH OF MN AS A HAIL/WIND THREAT. PLEASE REFER TO MCD NUMBER 1558 FOR FURTHER SHORT-TERM DETAILS.

sections.title: IA/IL
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER IA HAS PERSISTED FOR SEVERAL HOURS AND HAS DEVELOPED A WEAK ASSOCIATED MCV. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER THIS ACTIVITY WILL REJUVENATE LATER THIS AFTERNOON OR NEW STORMS WILL FORM NEAR AND AHEAD OF THE REMNANT CIRCULATION. HOWEVER...MOST 12Z MODEL SOLUTIONS NOW SUGGEST THAT THUNDERSTORMS WILL INTENSIFY IN THIS REGION. VERTICAL SHEAR IS ONLY MARGINAL FOR ORGANIZED STORMS. HOWEVER...STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND HIGH INSTABILITY WILL PROMOTE STRONG UP/DOWNDRAFTS AND THE THREAT OF HAIL AND GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: NORTHEAST CO/NEB
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE OFF THE MOUNTAINS OF CO/WY ONCE AGAIN TODAY AND SPREAD INTO THE PLAINS. HIGHER LOW-LEVEL THETA-E VALUES SUGGEST THAT STORMS MAY INTENSIFY AS THEY MOVE INTO WESTERN NEB AND PERSIST THROUGH MUCH OF THE NIGHT. IF THIS SCENARIO OCCURS...SCATTERED STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE STORMS WOULD BE THE MAIN THREAT. ..HART/LEITMAN.. 07/10/2011

sections.title: NRN PLAINS/UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: STORMS DEVELOPED EARLIER IN WRN ND AND HAVE BEEN SPREADING EWD ALONG A BOUNDARY LOCATED NEAR THE ND/SD BORDER. AS THESE STORMS TRACK EWD/ESEWD ALONG BOUNDARY...ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS ARE VERY FAVORABLE FOR INTENSE SUPERCELLS/SMALL BOWS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL...SOME WIND GUSTS OVER 75 MPH...AND EVEN A FEW TORNADOES. THEREFORE THIS AREA HAS BEEN UPGRADED TO A MODERATE RISK OVER A SMALL PORTION OF SRN ND...NRN SD AND FAR WRN MN. SOME HIGH RESOLUTION MODELS SUGGEST THESE STORMS MAY EVOLVE INTO A SMALL MCS AS THE STORMS MOVE INTO WRN MN THIS EVENING...AND THEN POSSIBLY CONTINUE SEWD INTO SRN WI/NRN IL AREA BY MORNING. THOUGH THE OVERALL INTENSITY MAY DIMINISH THROUGH THE NIGHT...GIVEN THE WEAK FORCING AND STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER...THE POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE MAY CONTINUE WITH THE STORMS UNTIL 06Z OR LATER.

sections.title: NRN WI
sections.text: FORCING IN THIS AREA IS WEAK...THOUGH A FEW HOURS OF HEATING HAS RESULTED IN CU TO RECENTLY DEVELOP. THOUGH DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...20-30 KT...SEVERE STORMS MAY EVOLVE THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

sections.title: ERN IA/NRN AND CENTRAL IL
sections.text: MCV HAS MOVED EWD INTO SRN WI AND THUS FAR LITTLE IN THE WAY OF CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED IN ASSOCIATION WITH THIS SYSTEM. HOWEVER...A FEW STORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED IN ERN IA AND HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO BECOME SEVERE IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...REFERENCE MD 1560. OTHERWISE...LITTLE CHANGE FROM EARLIER FORECAST. ..IMY.. 07/10/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1044 AM CDT SUN JUL 10 2011/ THE PRIMARY BAND OF FAST ZONAL WESTERLIES REMAINS ACROSS THE NORTHERN UNITED STATES TODAY...WHILE AN UPPER RIDGE AXIS EXTENDS FROM THE CENTRAL ROCKIES SOUTHEASTWARD INTO MS/AL/GA. SEVERAL SMALLER SCALE SHORTWAVE TROUGHS ARE EMBEDDED IN THE FLOW ACROSS THE NORTHERN ROCKIES AND PLAINS...AND WILL POTENTIALLY RESULT IN MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT.

sections.title: ERN SD INTO MN
sections.text: STORMS HAVE TRANSITIONED TO A LINEAR MODE THIS EVENING...WITH A THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS AHEAD OF THE ONGOING SYSTEM. THIS WILL INCLUDE PORTIONS OF FAR ERN SD AND MUCH OF CNTRL MN. THE 00Z MPX SOUNDING SHOWED MODEST INSTABILITY AND SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR/FLOW FOR A CONTINUED WIND AND HAIL THREAT. GIVEN LINEAR STORM MODE...HAVE DROPPED THE SIG HAIL DRIVEN MDT RISK...BUT HAVE MAINTAINED A CORRIDOR OF POTENTIAL SIG WIND. THIS MCS MAY PERSIST OVERNIGHT INTO NRN IL WITH WIND AND HAIL POSSIBLE.

sections.title: NERN CO...NEB
sections.text: CELLS HAVE BECOME QUITE STRONG WITHIN A GENERALLY DISORGANIZED CLUSTER OF CELLS FROM ERN CO INTO NWRN KS. THE 00Z LBF SOUNDING SHOWED ABOUT 3000 J/KG MLCAPE AND MARGINAL DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR SPLITTING CELLS. LARGE HAIL IS LIKELY WITH THE CORES MOVING NWD OUT OF KS/CO AS WELL AS WITH THE NEW ACTIVITY NW OF LBF. HAVE ADDED A 30% HAIL TO THIS AREA TO ACCOUNT FOR THIS. ..JEWELL.. 07/11/2011
